edition.en: Both inscriptions as given on Chinese Wikisource, compared with the Siku quanshu edition of the Zhangzi quanshu (books 1 and 3) in the Kanseki Repository. Where Wikisource writes 懮 the witness and the usual texts have 憂, and 錫類 (from the Zuozhuan’s 永錫爾類) is read for 賜類; the punctuation of the last sentence of the Western Inscription is corrected.
edition.zh: 两篇铭文据维基文库，并与京都大学汉籍资料库（Kanseki Repository）所收四库全书本《张子全书》卷一、卷三对校。维基文库作“懮”处，校本及通行本作“忧”，从之；“赐类”据《左传》“永锡尔类”及校本作“锡类”；《西铭》末句的标点也已改正。

basis.en: Northern Song prose; the author died in 1077.
basis.zh: 北宋散文，作者卒于 1077 年。

note.en: Zhang Zai hung these two short texts on the west and east windows of his study, under the names Correcting Obstinacy and Curing Folly; his friend Cheng Yi renamed them, and the Western Inscription became one of the most quoted pages of Song thought. It takes the language of a family and stretches it to cover everything: Heaven and Earth as parents, all people as siblings, all things as companions. The Eastern Inscription is its plain companion, about owning the words and acts that come from you.
note.zh: 张载把这两篇短文分别挂在书房的西窗和东窗上，原题《订顽》《砭愚》；后来程颐为它们改了名字，《西铭》成为宋代思想中被引用最多的篇章之一。它用一个家庭的语言去覆盖一切：天地是父母，百姓是同胞，万物是同伴。《东铭》是它朴素的姊妹篇，讲的是要认下出自自己的言语和行为。

excerpt.en: All people are my brothers and sisters; all things are my companions.

gloss.en: Qian and Kun are the first two hexagrams of the Book of Changes, standing for Heaven and Earth.
gloss.zh: 乾、坤是《周易》的头两卦，分别代表天和地。

gloss.en: Placed in the middle of them, mingled with them into one.
gloss.zh: 混合无间地处在天地之中。

gloss.at: 天地之塞，吾其體；天地之帥，吾其性
gloss.en: The words come from Mencius: the vital energy that “fills” Heaven and Earth, and the will that “commands” that energy.
gloss.zh: 语出《孟子》：浩然之气“塞于天地之间”，“志，气之帅也”。塞，充塞；帅，统率。
gloss.at_hans: 天地之塞，吾其体；天地之帅，吾其性

gloss.en: 與: a companion, one of my kind.
The eldest son of the main line, and the steward who manages his household.
The infirm, the crippled and sick, those without brothers or children, the widowed and the wifeless.
gloss.zh: 疲癃，衰老多病；残疾，伤残有病；茕独，无兄弟、无子女的人；鳏寡，丧妻、丧夫的人。

gloss.en: Those in hardship with no one to appeal to.
gloss.zh: 困苦而无处诉说的人。颠连，困顿。

gloss.en: From the Book of Songs: not to be ashamed even in the north-west corner of the room, the most hidden place in a house.
gloss.zh: 语出《诗经·大雅·抑》：在屋子西北角最隐蔽处也不做愧心之事。屋漏，室内西北角。

gloss.en: Yu the Great, son of Gun, lord of Chong, who according to Mencius disliked fine wine; here he cares for his parents by it.
gloss.zh: 崇伯，鲧；崇伯子，即大禹。《孟子》说禹“恶旨酒”；顾养，照顾奉养父母。

gloss.en: Ying Kaoshu, border warden of Ying in the Zuozhuan, whose devotion to his mother moved his lord to filial feeling; the Zuozhuan applies to him the line “you will long bestow it on your kind”.
gloss.zh: 颍封人，即《左传》中的颍考叔，他的孝心感动了郑庄公。《左传》引《诗》“孝子不匮，永锡尔类”赞他。锡，赐予。

gloss.en: To bring about contentment: Mencius says Shun laboured until his difficult father was content.
gloss.zh: 使父亲欢悦。《孟子》说舜“尽事亲之道而瞽瞍厎豫”。

gloss.en: Shensheng, heir of the state of Jin, who would not flee when falsely accused and so died obedient.
gloss.zh: 申生，春秋时晋献公的太子，被诬陷后不肯出逃，顺从而死。

gloss.en: Zeng Shen, Confucius’s disciple, who on his deathbed showed that he was returning his body undamaged to his parents.
gloss.zh: 曾参，孔子弟子。他临终时让弟子看自己的手足，表示把父母给的身体完整地归还。

gloss.en: Boqi, son of Yin Jifu, who obeyed even when driven out of his home on a stepmother’s slander.
gloss.zh: 伯奇，周代尹吉甫的儿子，被后母谗害逐出家门，仍顺从父命。

gloss.en: Will polish you like jade into what you are to become. 庸 means “by this”.
gloss.zh: 用来像琢玉一样磨炼你，使你有所成就。庸，用。

gloss.en: The Eastern Inscription begins here; its first title was Curing Folly.
The four limbs, that is, one’s bodily actions.
